      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies CMakeLists.txt to enable `-Wunused` compiler warning flags across the build.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Enabling `-Wunused` prevents silent accumulation of dead code and helps avoid bugs where parameters are accidentally forgotten. The author cites a recent case where forgotten code was mistaken for dead code (#36137) and eight dead-code PRs merged within two months, showing real hygiene value that is nonetheless reasonably deferrable."
    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",

      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical parameter silencing following from the build flag change does not constitute substantive work in indexes."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches libmultiprocess and IPC headers mechanically to silence unused parameter warnings.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Includes temporary unmerged subtree changes and mechanical parameter silencing without affecting IPC architecture or interfaces."
    },

    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",

      "band": "Unranked",
